instructions.purpose: List the saved automations in this chat.

tool.name: automation-list
tool.description: Returns each automation's name, status, failureCount, lastError, allowedOrigins, instructions, and outputCapBytes. Never includes source. Takes no parameters.

usage_rules.rule: Use when the user asks which automations exist, or to find the exact name of the automation they mean.
Mention paused automations and their lastError so the user can ask for a fix.

example.context: User asks: "What automations do I have?"
